Companies like @Amazon, @Microsoft, & @Google are building tools that actually intensify injustice. We wrote this letter urging them to show that #BlackLivesMatter. #TechisNotNeutral #DefundthePolice #NoTechforICE https://t.co/m23U8klCcW https://t.co/CTqWCv3EGd

Where we are politically currently is intentional. It comes on the back of Black+Brown folks w/the war on drugs, community policing, for profit prisons, military grade weapons used on citizens. All this under the guise of protect and serve. #BlackLivesMatter

Racial equity, economic justice, & environmental justice are tied together. #Strike4BlackLives demands corporations not just tokenize #BLM with tweets, but actively pay workers living wages and protect essential workers' health and safety https://t.co/MwVijgJvaD https://t.co/SeWmiF7hxc

It's also important to note, people are being attacked because they're showing up for Black lives. Not even whiteness / proximity to whiteness protects them from state sanctioned violence for allying themselves with Black protesters. #BlackLivesMatter

@chicagosmayor Wow we also know some folks who can engage 👀 👀 + are VERY energized about shaping our democracy into something that works for us ALL. Hint: it's us. We're the folks, here's an outline: #BlackLivesMatter #FreeThemAll #DefundthePolice #CommunityMutualAid #LANDBACK

This #BlackAugust we study political prisoners, and the means by which society pushes people into becoming political prisoners whether it be 'committing crimes of poverty', or blessedly minding their own business. To #MikeBrown, we love you, we are all forever changed by you #BLM
